newsitem.title: INDIA: Political worries weigh down Indian shares.
newsitem.headline: Political worries weigh down Indian shares.

text.p: ** (1400 GMT) - Indian stocks finish with sharp losses, but
remain above day's lowest levels, halting market slide
** Bombay 30-share index falls 96.96 points, or 2.24 pct,
** Market in initial knee-jerk reaction after regional
Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party says plans to pull
out of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's ruling United
Front govt citing differences with coalition partners
** Traders see no immediate threat to Gujral's govt as DMK
says will continue to support Gujral's government
** Delhi share index off 3.3 pct at 891.56, Madras 2.19
pct at 4,271.23 and Calcutta 3.20 pct at 130.54
